findings.title: Broad descriptions omitted concrete tasks
findings.evidence: Zoom variants,screen recording,master variants and3D animations lacked practical treatment.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit task teaching,per-objective mapping and completion evidence.
findings.resolution: Add explicit task teaching,per-objective mapping and completion evidence.

findings.title: Compression is not content-neutral
findings.evidence: Microsoft documents loss of embedded subtitles and alternate audio tracks.
findings.recommendation: Retain original and verify accessible playback of final media output.
findings.resolution: Retain original and verify accessible playback of final media output.

findings.title: Visual layer order is not sufficient accessibility evidence
findings.evidence: Reading Order uses numbered sequence; grouping animated objects can remove effects.
findings.recommendation: Teach separate checks and retest motion after accessibility edits.
findings.resolution: Teach separate checks and retest motion after accessibility edits.

findings.title: Zoom navigation defaults differ
findings.evidence: Section/Summary return by default; Slide Zoom continues by default.
findings.recommendation: Add a route exercise with explicit Return to Zoom.
findings.resolution: Add a route exercise with explicit Return to Zoom.

findings.title: Recent SmartArt behavior is build-dependent
findings.evidence: August2026 article describes programmatic accessibility-tree updates on specified Windows subscription builds.
findings.recommendation: Add bounded useful article and verify actual spoken relationships.
findings.resolution: Add bounded useful article and verify actual spoken relationships.
